best_section.where: southern two-thirds of the kerb, past the bend, alongside the grey-roofed house

drivers.road: Quiet curving residential street next to a rail corridor, no sign of through traffic.
drivers.room_and_convention: A car/trailer sits near the bend and a car is parked kerbside further down, so roadside parking isn't unusual, but the carriageway is narrow.
drivers.houses: A house sits only around 10 m from the kerb for the best (flattest) section, with no screening on that side.

flags: House very close (~10 m) with no buffer — drives the poor verdict
Trees spilling from the rail embankment crowd the northern ~10 m of the kerb
Slope moderate at best section (~2%) but steeper (6-7%) over other stretches
reasons: Narrow kerb, only one car seen parked
summary: Quiet bend, but the only flat, clear stretch runs right past a house with no buffer.
sun_shade: Trees from the rail corridor shade the northern end; the best section further south is more open, with the house block to the east giving some morning shade.
